'''Padded armor''' was a type of [[battle armor]], but was typically much lighter than most. This allowed more flexibility and movement to the wearer. Yet because of this, it was much less resistant to damage than the average battle armor.

==Description==
Padded armors offered protection against kinetic damage as well as from energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="SWG:CU" /> A typical complete armor set included helmet, chest plate, left & right biceps, left & right bracers, gloves, belt, leggings and boots. Padded armor also came in a wide variety of colors.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

A model of padded armor was the '''Covert Ops armor''' sometimes used by [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> Another model was the [[Alliance Cold Weather armor]].<ref name="SWG:C11">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 11: The Battle of Echo Base}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]] was known to sometimes wear padded armor.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> A padded chest plate was allegedly worn by [[Melnea Arnthout]] at the time of the crash of the [[Dowager Queen/Legends|''Dowager Queen'']] and the subsequent settlement of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Arnthout's Armor}}</ref>

Padded armors were widely used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" /> They were worn for instance by [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]],<ref name="OS">"[[Operation: Shadowpoint]]"</ref> by Rebel guard [[Captain/Legends|captains]] and [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|Alliance SpecForce]] personnel,<ref name="SWG" /> including [[Wilderness Fighters|cold weather commandos]],<ref name="SWG:C11" /> and by numerous criminals as well.<ref name="SWG" />

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] also both wore varieties of padded battle armor.<ref name="WDNTS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050120a|text=We Don't Need That Scum}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a trader encountered the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauder]] [[armorsmith]] [[Macchbraus]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Macchbraus requested the trader to craft him [[Bone armor|bone]], [[Composite armor|composite]], [[Mabari armor|Mabari]] and padded armors in exchange for teaching him to create [[Marauder Assault Armor|Marauder]] [[Marauder Reconnaissance Armor|armors]].<ref name="SWG:GU5">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Game Update 5}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Padded armor was a type of armor used by players in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
